items.en: Added a transcript line when a plugin that runs first skips one of your mod's hooks, naming the event and the plugin
items.zh: 当先运行的 plugin 跳过你的 mod 的某个 hook 时，新增一条记录行，注明事件和该 plugin

items.en: Added `decider: "person"` to a mod's `tool.check` answer: only the permission dialog or a host's callback can approve the ask, and it is refused with the mod's reason where nobody can be asked
items.zh: 在 mod 的 `tool.check` 应答中新增 `decider: "person"`：只有权限对话框或宿主的回调可以批准该请求，在无人可询问的情况下会以 mod 给出的原因拒绝

items.en: Added `e.isReadOnly` to a mod's `tool.check` event, set when the tool call is read-only
items.zh: 在 mod 的 `tool.check` 事件中新增 `e.isReadOnly`，当工具调用为只读时设置

items.en: Added `/auto-mode-setup`: a guided setup that reads your project and recent sessions to teach auto mode about your environment, now also available on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, Claude apps gateway and telemetry-disabled sessions
items.zh: 新增 `/auto-mode-setup`：引导式设置，读取你的项目和最近的 session，让自动模式了解你的环境，现已在 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry、Claude 应用网关和禁用遥测的 session 中可用

items.en: Added `/claude-api managed-agents-secure`, which compares a Managed Agents agent's settings with Anthropic's published security guide, without changing anything
items.zh: 新增 `/claude-api managed-agents-secure`，将 Managed Agents agent 的设置与 Anthropic 发布的安全指南进行比对，不做任何更改

items.en: Added the names of the tools called earlier to the compaction summary in the transcript view (Ctrl+O)
items.zh: 在记录视图（Ctrl+O）的上下文压缩摘要中新增此前调用的工具名称

items.en: Added a warning on Pro and Max plans when resuming an inactive conversation would use a noticeable share of your 5-hour usage limit: resume anyway, or start a new conversation and Claude can look up the previous one if you refer to it
items.zh: 在 Pro 和 Max 套餐中新增警告：恢复不活跃的对话会占用你 5 小时用量限制中相当可观的一部分时提示：仍要恢复，或开始新对话，若你提及之前的对话，Claude 可以查找它

items.en: \[VSCode] Added mod drawing in the chat panel for sessions on Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI and Microsoft Foundry, behind an LLM gateway, or with telemetry turned off
items.zh: \[VSCode] 在聊天面板中新增 mod 绘制，适用于 Amazon Bedrock、Google Vertex AI 和 Microsoft Foundry 上的 session、经 LLM 网关的 session，或关闭遥测的 session

items.en: \[Code Review] Added review levels to Code Review: Owners choose Quick, Standard (the default), or Deep for the organization, and can give individual repositories their own level
items.zh: \[Code Review] 为 Code Review 新增审查级别：所有者可为组织选择 Quick、Standard（默认）或 Deep，并可为单个仓库指定各自的级别

items.en: \[Code Review] Added an option in Code Review admin settings to review every repository in a GitHub organization, including ones added later, without selecting them one by one
items.zh: \[Code Review] 在 Code Review 管理设置中新增选项，可审查 GitHub 组织中的所有仓库，包括之后新增的仓库，无需逐个选择

items.en: Changed mods' `settings.read` hooks to receive each settings layer and rewrite the merged settings, so a managed mod can make an organization's setting a ceiling, including the `cleanupPeriodDays` the retention sweep uses
items.zh: 变更 mod 的 `settings.read` hook：改为接收每个设置层并重写合并后的设置，使受管理的 mod 能将组织设置设为上限，包括保留清理所用的 `cleanupPeriodDays`

items.en: Changed the `/artifacts` delete confirmation to show numbered choices: 1 or Enter keeps the artifact, 2 deletes it, and y, n and Esc still work
items.zh: 变更 `/artifacts` 删除确认，改为显示编号选项：1 或 Enter 保留 artifact，2 删除它，y、n 和 Esc 仍然有效

items.en: Changed the question that turns on the mods Claude writes in a session to plain text with no link or session id; it stays up when a new turn starts, and Claude tells you what loaded when you turn them on
items.zh: 变更开启 Claude 在 session 中编写的 mod 的提问，改为纯文本，不含链接或 session id；新回合开始时仍会显示，开启后 Claude 会告知你加载了什么

items.en: Changed tool search to be on by default behind a custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`; a 400 or 422 from the gateway is retried without it
items.zh: 变更工具搜索：在自定义 `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` 下默认开启；网关返回 400 或 422 时会在不启用它的情况下重试

items.en: Changed compaction to send Claude the skill list again afterwards; `/reload-skills` now sends only new or changed skills
items.zh: 变更上下文压缩：之后会再次向 Claude 发送 skill 列表；`/reload-skills` 现在只发送新增或变更的 skill

items.en: Changed skill hooks: the skills of one source (a repo, your own folder, or a plugin) can register at most 1,024 hooks and 16,384 matcher characters per session
items.zh: 变更 skill hook：同一来源（一个仓库、你自己的文件夹或一个 plugin）的 skill 每个 session 最多可注册 1,024 个 hook 和 16,384 个匹配字符

items.en: Changed skills under a policy that allows hooks from plugins only: a skill used in the main conversation whose hooks are kept out no longer gets its `allowed-tools`
items.zh: 变更仅允许来自 plugin 的 hook 的策略下的 skill：在主对话中使用但其 hook 被排除的 skill 不再获得其 `allowed-tools`

items.en: Updated the /claude-api skill to use the `ant` CLI on Claude Platform on AWS instead of falling back to the SDK or curl
items.zh: 更新 /claude-api skill，在 Claude Platform on AWS 上使用 `ant` CLI，而不再回退到 SDK 或 curl

items.en: Removed the notes from `claude plugin validate` that predicted where a mod's hooks would run
items.zh: 移除 `claude plugin validate` 中预测 mod 的 hook 将在何处运行的说明

items.en: Removed the "(research preview)" label from the `/fast` dialog title on Opus 5.5
items.zh: 移除 Opus 5.5 上 `/fast` 对话框标题中的“(research preview)”标签

items.en: \[VSCode] Changed background sub-agents to show as one status line under their Agent card instead of streaming every step into the chat; the full transcript stays in /tasks
items.zh: \[VSCode] 变更后台 subagent 的显示方式：现在在其 Agent 卡片下以一行状态栏展示，不再把每一步都流式输出到聊天中；完整记录仍保留在 /tasks 中

items.en: Improved `/usage` to say when a rate limit on usage data ends instead of "try again in a moment"
items.zh: 改进 `/usage`：用量数据的速率限制结束时，会说明结束时间，不再显示“try again in a moment”

items.en: Improved the lines shown when a mod written in the session loads, reloads or fails to load
items.zh: 改进 session 中编写的 mod 在加载、重新加载或加载失败时显示的行

items.en: Improved artifacts with several views: when you ask for links to them, Claude now writes out each view's link and explains that the address bar stays the same as you switch views
items.zh: 改进包含多个视图的 artifact：当你要求提供它们的链接时，Claude 现在会写出每个视图的链接，并说明切换视图时地址栏保持不变

items.en: Improved cloud sessions: a new conversation's first turn no longer waits for the local (stdio) MCP servers of plugins synced from claude.ai, unless a server sets `alwaysLoad: true`
items.zh: 改进云 session：新对话的第一轮不再等待从 claude.ai 同步的 plugin 的本地（stdio）MCP server，除非该 server 设置了 `alwaysLoad: true`

items.en: Improved how a remote session recovers its status when the server refuses a status update that carried other session data
items.zh: 改进远程 session 在 server 拒绝携带其他 session 数据的 status 更新时恢复其 status 的方式

items.en: Improved session file size in auto mode: the safety classifier's context is no longer stored with every request
items.zh: 改进自动模式下的 session 文件大小：安全分类器的上下文不再随每个请求一起存储

items.en: Improved the `claude -p` invalid-settings warning: a file that did not load lists only what stopped it, and long lists are capped per file
items.zh: 改进 `claude -p` 的无效设置警告：未加载的文件只列出阻止其加载的原因，过长的列表按文件截断

items.en: Improved resume of large compacted sessions in SDK and headless mode: the first request after resuming is sent sooner
items.zh: 改进 SDK 和无头模式下恢复大型已压缩 session：恢复后的第一个请求发送得更快

items.en: Improved responsiveness and throughput when many subagents are running at the same time
items.zh: 改进大量 subagent 同时运行时的响应速度和吞吐量

items.en: Improved memory use when sending requests in long or resumed conversations
items.zh: 改进在长对话或恢复的对话中发送请求时的内存占用

items.en: Self-hosted runner: Improved the error shown when the git host answers "not found" for a session's repository: it now names the repository and whom to ask
items.zh: 自托管运行器：改进 git 主机对 session 仓库返回“not found”时显示的报错：现在会指明仓库名称以及应向谁询问

items.en: Windows: Improved git command start-up with a standard Git for Windows install by running its git.exe directly instead of through its cmd launcher
items.zh: Windows：改进标准 Git for Windows 安装下 git 命令的启动速度，直接运行其 git.exe，而不再通过其 cmd 启动器

items.en: Fixed the organization policy not refreshing until the hourly check after approving an `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` at startup or switching "Use custom API key" in `/config`
items.zh: 修复了以下问题：启动时批准 `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` 或在 `/config` 中切换“Use custom API key”后，组织策略要等到每小时检查时才刷新

items.en: Fixed sandboxed commands failing to start on Linux when a `sandbox.filesystem.denyRead` glob contains brackets that are not a character class, such as a `[user-id]` route folder
items.zh: 修复在 Linux 上，当 `sandbox.filesystem.denyRead` 通配符包含非字符类的方括号（例如 `[user-id]` 路由文件夹）时，沙箱命令无法启动的问题

items.en: Fixed `rm -r` of a mounted drive or a folder at its top level (`/Volumes`, `/media`, WSL's `/mnt/c`) not getting the safety prompt that `rm -rf /Applications` gets
items.zh: 修复对已挂载驱动器或其顶层文件夹（`/Volumes`、`/media`、WSL 的 `/mnt/c`）执行 `rm -r` 时，未像 `rm -rf /Applications` 那样触发安全提示的问题

items.en: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_TRANSCRIPT_LOCAL_GC` dropping messages from the saved transcript when the disk filled up while the file was being trimmed
items.zh: 修复在文件裁剪过程中磁盘写满时，`CLAUDE_CODE_TRANSCRIPT_LOCAL_GC` 会从已保存的记录中丢失消息的问题

items.en: Fixed a plugin keeping a headless run going past `--max-turns`, Stop, or ended input by spawning subagents or re-running a finished one
items.zh: 修复 plugin 通过启动 subagent 或重新运行已完成的 subagent，使无头运行超出 `--max-turns`、Stop 或已结束输入的问题

items.en: Fixed a failed mod reload removing the tools and commands of the version that stays loaded, and its messages being wrong or silent about whether the previous version is still loaded
items.zh: 修复 mod 重新加载失败时会移除仍处于加载状态的版本的工具和命令，以及其消息在说明前一版本是否仍加载时出错或静默的问题

items.en: Fixed a click on a mod's button being lost when buttons with the same label and no `key` were redrawn unchanged
items.zh: 修复当标签相同且没有 `key` 的按钮被原样重绘时，点击 mod 按钮会丢失的问题

items.en: Fixed mod sharing in the built-in `plugin-authoring` skill stopping at the secret scan on machines with managed settings and on Team and Enterprise plans
items.zh: 修复了内置 `plugin-authoring` skill 中的 mod 共享在启用了托管设置的机器上以及 Team 和 Enterprise 套餐上停在密钥扫描环节的问题

items.en: Fixed scheduled Cowork cloud sessions waiting five minutes again for each subagent whose WebFetch needed a URL approval that nobody was there to give
items.zh: 修复了定时 Cowork 云端 session 中，每个 subagent 的 WebFetch 需要 URL 审批却无人审批时，会再次等待五分钟的问题

items.en: Fixed Write results and rejected edits showing a file outside the working directory as `../../…`; they now show `~/…` or the full path
items.zh: 修复了 Write 结果和被拒绝的编辑将工作目录之外的文件显示为 `../../…` 的问题；现在显示 `~/…` 或完整路径

items.en: Fixed a claude.ai Directory plugin's skills not running as commands when picked from the "/" menu in Cowork cloud sessions
items.zh: 修复了在 Cowork 云端 session 中从 "/" 菜单选择 claude.ai Directory plugin 的 skills 时，这些 skills 未作为命令运行的问题

items.en: Fixed Remote Control permanently withholding a desktop conversation's history when a different account was signed in to the terminal
items.zh: 修复了终端登录了其他账号时，远程控制永久扣留桌面对话历史的问题

items.en: Fixed Remote Control failing to start from Claude Desktop when DISABLE\_TELEMETRY or DO\_NOT\_TRACK is set on a paid plan
items.zh: 修复了在付费套餐上设置了 DISABLE\_TELEMETRY 或 DO\_NOT\_TRACK 时，远程控制无法从 Claude Desktop 启动的问题

items.en: Fixed model switches, messages and interrupts waiting behind a context usage check in SDK and desktop sessions
items.zh: 修复了在 SDK 和桌面 session 中，模型切换、消息和中断排在上下文用量检查之后等待的问题

items.en: Fixed `context_management: Extra inputs are not permitted` errors behind LLM gateways; Claude Code now resends the request without that field
items.zh: 修复了 LLM 网关后出现 `context_management: Extra inputs are not permitted` 错误的问题；Claude Code 现在会去掉该字段重新发送请求

items.en: Fixed OpenTelemetry settings delivered through server-managed settings being ignored for the whole session after signing in during first-run setup or the first start after /logout
items.zh: 修复了在首次运行设置或 /logout 后首次启动期间登录后，通过服务器托管设置下发的 OpenTelemetry 设置在整个 session 中被忽略的问题

items.en: Fixed unsandboxed Bash commands in Claude Desktop Code tab sessions on macOS and Linux not seeing environment variables exported in shell startup files such as \~/.zshrc
items.zh: 修复了 macOS 和 Linux 上 Claude Desktop Code 标签页 session 中未沙箱化的 Bash 命令看不到 shell 启动文件（如 \~/.zshrc）中导出的环境变量的问题

items.en: Fixed the Consumer Terms notice being skipped for a day or longer after a server error
items.zh: 修复了服务器错误后消费者条款通知被跳过一天或更久的问题

items.en: Fixed `/privacy-settings` offering choices that may not apply to you after a network or server error
items.zh: 修复了网络或服务器错误后 `/privacy-settings` 提供可能不适用于你的选项的问题

items.en: Fixed a "Context limit reached" or "Prompt is too long" error after stopping a turn while Claude Code was compacting a conversation the API had rejected as too long
items.zh: 修复了在 Claude Code 对 API 判定为过长的对话进行上下文压缩时停止回合后出现 "Context limit reached" 或 "Prompt is too long" 错误的问题

items.en: Fixed subagents sometimes forgetting their most recent work when they were messaged or resumed right after finishing
items.zh: 修复了 subagents 在刚完成工作后立即收到消息或被恢复时，有时忘记最近工作内容的问题

items.en: Fixed `claude --help` text for `--tools`, `--resume`, `--debug`, `--json-schema`, `--disable-slash-commands`, `--system-prompt-snapshot` and `claude update` to match actual behavior
items.zh: 修复了 `claude --help` 中 `--tools`、`--resume`、`--debug`、`--json-schema`、`--disable-slash-commands`、`--system-prompt-snapshot` 和 `claude update` 的说明与实际行为不符的问题

items.en: Fixed `claude --worktree` removing the worktree and its branch without asking at exit when HEAD was detached or on another branch, which could lose commits
items.zh: 修复了当 HEAD 处于分离状态或位于其他分支时，`claude --worktree` 在退出时不询问就删除 worktree 及其分支、可能丢失提交的问题

items.en: Fixed resumed and cloud sessions sending Claude the whole skill list again each time plugins reloaded at startup
items.zh: 修复了恢复的 session 和云端 session 在启动时每次 plugins 重新加载都向 Claude 重新发送完整 skill 列表的问题

items.en: Fixed an interrupt not ending a Read that waits on an idle pipe or device named like an image
items.zh: 修复了中断无法结束等待空闲管道或名称类似图片的设备的 Read 的问题

items.en: Fixed `/effort status`, `/effort ultracode` and the prompt's effort indicator showing a guessed effort level when `CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL` is `auto` or `unset` and no level is sent
items.zh: 修复了当 `CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL` 为 `auto` 或 `unset` 且未发送级别时，`/effort status`、`/effort ultracode` 和 prompt 的 effort 指示器显示猜测的 effort 级别的问题

items.en: Fixed a PreToolUse hook's deny reason being replaced by a timeout error when an Agent SDK callback hook on the same tool call timed out
items.zh: 修复了当同一工具调用上的 Agent SDK 回调 hook 超时时，PreToolUse hook 的拒绝原因被超时错误替换的问题

items.en: Fixed Bash and PowerShell deleting a large command's output file when it could not be copied to the session's tool-results folder, unless the disk is full
items.zh: 修复了 Bash 和 PowerShell 在无法将大型命令的输出文件复制到 session 的 tool-results 文件夹时将其删除的问题（磁盘已满时除外）

items.en: Fixed notes typed into a multiple-choice question with previews being cut off with "…" in terminals under about 100 columns, hiding what was typed (anthropics/claude-code#82768)
items.zh: 修复了在宽度约 100 列以下的 terminal 中，带预览的多选题里输入的备注被“…”截断、导致输入内容不可见的问题（anthropics/claude-code#82768）

items.en: Fixed self-paced `/loop` wakeups scheduled at the 1-hour maximum firing just after the 1-hour prompt cache expired, so those wakeups no longer re-read the conversation uncached
items.zh: 修复了自定节奏的 `/loop` 唤醒被安排在 1 小时上限、恰好在 1 小时 prompt 缓存过期后触发的问题，这些唤醒不再以未缓存方式重新读取对话

items.en: Fixed agent teams: approving a shutdown request from the main session no longer exits the whole CLI
items.zh: 修复了 agent teams：从主 session 批准关闭请求不再退出整个 CLI

items.en: Fixed a skill's `once` hook also removing another skill's identical hook after it ran
items.zh: 修复了某个 skill 的 `once` hook 运行后还会移除另一个 skill 的相同 hook 的问题

items.en: Fixed transcript mode's `{` and `}` landing the prompt on an inconsistent row, or off screen, instead of the transcript's first row
items.zh: 修复了 transcript 模式下的 `{` 和 `}` 将 prompt 定位到不一致的行或屏幕外，而不是 transcript 第一行的问题

items.en: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW=200k` silently setting a 100K window: the variable now accepts `k` and `M` suffixes like `--autocompact`, and warns when a value is out of range or ignored
items.zh: 修复了 `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW=200k` 会静默设置 100K 窗口的问题：该变量现在像 `--autocompact` 一样接受 `k` 和 `M` 后缀，并在值超出范围或被忽略时发出警告

items.en: Fixed Ctrl+C in the agents view clearing a text selection without copying it when pressed before the mouse button was released
items.zh: 修复了在 agents 视图中，若在松开鼠标按钮前按下 Ctrl+C，会清除文本选择而不复制的问题

items.en: \[VSCode] Fixed one cause of sessions failing to start with "Subprocess initialization did not complete within 60000ms": time a SessionStart command hook spends running no longer counts toward the limit, up to 10 minutes in total
items.zh: \[VSCode] 修复了 session 以“Subprocess initialization did not complete within 60000ms”启动失败的一个原因：SessionStart 命令 hook 的运行时间不再计入该限制，总计最多 10 分钟

items.en: \[VSCode] Fixed a session closed while it was starting keeping its Claude Code process running until the start ended
items.zh: \[VSCode] 修复了在启动过程中关闭的 session 会使其 Claude Code 进程一直运行到启动结束的问题

items.en: \[VSCode] Fixed a mod's drawings disappearing from a long-open panel until the next turn on machines that also run an older Claude Code
items.zh: \[VSCode] 修复了在同时运行旧版 Claude Code 的机器上，mod 的绘图会从长时间打开的面板中消失、直到下一轮才恢复的问题

items.en: \[VSCode] Fixed Past conversations hiding sessions when `claudeCode.claudeProcessWrapper` is set
items.zh: \[VSCode] 修复了设置 `claudeCode.claudeProcessWrapper` 时 Past conversations 会隐藏 session 的问题

items.en: \[Cloud sessions] Fixed folders in the composer's @ list showing no name in cloud sessions, where picking one added only a space instead of a mention
items.zh: \[Cloud sessions] 修复了云 session 中 composer 的 @ 列表里的文件夹不显示名称的问题，此前选择文件夹只会添加一个空格而不是提及

items.en: \[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude going silent in a thread when its channel becomes shared across Enterprise Grid workspaces mid-task; it now posts a one-time note to @-mention it in a new thread
items.zh: \[Claude Tag] 修复了任务进行中 channel 在 Enterprise Grid 工作区之间变为共享时，Claude 在 thread 中不再响应的问题；现在它会发布一条一次性提示，请在新 thread 中 @ 提及它

items.en: \[Claude Tag] Fixed `@Claude !fork` typed outside a thread getting no visible reply; Claude now shows you a private note saying to run it from inside a thread
items.zh: \[Claude Tag] 修复了在 thread 外输入 `@Claude !fork` 得不到可见回复的问题；Claude 现在会向你显示一条私密提示，说明需在 thread 内运行

items.en: \[Code Review] Fixed pull requests opened within a minute or two of an admin turning on Code Review being silently skipped; they are now retried and reviewed
items.zh: \[Code Review] 修复了在管理员开启 Code Review 后一两分钟内打开的 pull request 被静默跳过的问题；现在会重试并审查它们

summary.tldr: 新增自动模式引导与 mod 钩子能力，修复沙箱、worktree 与上下文压缩等多处问题。

highlights.title: 新增 /auto-mode-setup 引导
highlights.detail: 读取项目与近期 session，让自动模式了解你的环境；Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry、网关及禁用遥测的 session 也可用。

highlights.title: mod 钩子能力增强
highlights.detail: tool.check 新增 decider:"person" 与 isReadOnly；被跳过的钩子会记录事件与 plugin，便于排查。

highlights.title: settings.read 钩子行为变更
highlights.detail: 改为接收每个设置层并重写合并后的设置，受管理的 mod 可据此将组织设置设为上限。
highlights.action: 检查依赖 settings.read 的 mod，按新的分层输入与合并输出逻辑调整。

highlights.title: 工具搜索默认开启
highlights.detail: 自定义 ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL 下默认启用；网关返回 400 或 422 时会自动在不启用的情况下重试。

highlights.title: 修复 worktree 误删风险
highlights.detail: HEAD 处于分离状态或其他分支时，claude --worktree 退出不再未经询问删除 worktree 及其分支，避免丢失提交。

highlights.title: 修复沙箱与危险删除提示
highlights.detail: Linux 上 denyRead 通配符含方括号时沙箱可正常启动；对已挂载驱动器顶层执行 rm -r 现在会触发安全提示。
